# axm subagents new

Create a new subagent

## When to use

Create a new subagent

## Usage

```bash
axm subagents new [flags] <name>
```

## Arguments

| Name   | Type   | Required | Description                          |
| ------ | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `name` | string | Yes      | Name of the subagent (without owner) |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                            |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--owner`       | string  | No       | Override the workspace owner (e.g., @acme)             |
| `--agent`       | string  | No       | Agent IDs to target (can be repeated)                  |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Create the subagent without confirmation               |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Overwrite if a subagent with this name already exists  |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what files would be created without creating them |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Scaffold a new subagent**

```bash
axm subagents new my-subagent
```

**Create under a specific owner**

```bash
axm subagents new my-subagent --owner @acme
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
